description: ISIN check digit (ISO 6166). Two letters, nine letters or digits, one check digit. Letters expand to their alphabet position (A = 10) and the Luhn sum of that digit string must be 0. The prefix must be an ISO country code or one of the substitute prefixes EU, QS, QT, XA, XB, XC, XD, XF, XK, XS. Spaces are ignored. The national security id inside is not looked up. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/isin-validate
name: isin_validate
title: Isin Validate
